{{Top|leg}}
The '''Stasis Room''' in the [[XoXaan's Temple]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] was used by the [[One Sith]] as of [[137 ABY]]. It was here that [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] brought the body of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] after his [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Battle on Had Abbadon]]. To maintain control of the order, Darth Wyyrlok placed Krayt's body in the Stasis Room so that others would think that Krayt still lived, allowing Wyyrlok to act as Krayt's [[Voice]] and [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] while secretly controlling the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]].

[[Saarai (Chagrian)|Saarai]], and later [[Darth Talon]], were charged by Lord Wyyrlok with the task of guarding the room from unwelcome visitors.
